library.name: Movement ladder
library.setup: All pairs spread across both courts. No teams yet.
steps: Baseline to net and back, 4-5 mid-tempo runs.
Each player calls one movement for the next length: skips, side-steps, split-steps, drop-steps.
Build intensity up, then ease back into mobility.
library.cue: Quiet feet, early to the ball. One reminder only.

library.name: Pepper progression
library.setup: In pairs on half a court.
steps: Dig -> set -> controlled hit, keep it alive.
2nd and 3rd contact stay controlled - chase long rallies.
Last 2 min: allow harder controlled hits.
library.cue: Reward rallies that stay alive, not winners.

library.name: Serve targets + first contact
library.setup: Groups of 3: one server behind the baseline, one receiver opposite, one target 1–2 m off the net. Use separate lanes for controlled serves; use the full court for zone serving.
steps: Server names a zone before serving: deep seam, deep corner, or short.
Passer calls the ball early - short / deep / wind - and passes to a target by the net.
Swap server/passer every minute; count clean passes as a pair.
library.cue: Every serve has a named target. A serve with no plan is a wasted rep.

library.name: Two-touch attack, imperfect pass
library.setup: 2v2 full court. One tough serve at a receiver.
steps: Serve to the receiver, who passes high toward their partner.
The partner attacks the second contact if the ball is playable; otherwise send a controlled free ball.
Each side has a maximum of two contacts; continue the rally until the ball is dead.
library.cue: Good decisions from bad passes - that is the whole beach game.

library.name: Lateral set reps
library.setup: Groups of 3 on one side: feeder deep, setter moving from reception base, target near the sideline and 1–2 m off the net.
steps: Feeder tosses a simulated pass toward the setter near the net.
Setter moves under the ball and sets along the net toward the target, who catches.
Rotate feeder → setter → target after 5 balls. Progress to a controlled attack over the net.
library.cue: Hands high, set the line - no rushing the feet.

library.name: Perfect side-out - zones
library.setup: Per court: 2 teams on, the rest rotate in after each finished attack.
steps: You only score by landing an attack in a marked zone: deep corners + short.
First-ball side-out into a zone = point; dig-and-hit into a zone in transition = point.
Outside a zone = no point. Rotate the waiting team in after the rally ends; never enter while a ball is live.
library.cue: Tempts the high deep line shot. Reward smart shot selection over power.

library.name: Serve vs side-out game
library.setup: Winner stays, loser out, next team serves in (mini King of the Court).
steps: Serving team scores +2 for an ace.
Receiving team attacks into either marked 1 m-wide sideline strip: +1 inside the strip, −1 for an attack outside it. Play the rally out before rotating.
First to 8 wins the round, then swap who serves; winner holds court.
library.cue: Risk management: when is the aggressive serve or line shot worth it?

library.name: 1-2-3 Wash
library.setup: 2v2, one serving side. Extra teams queue to enter.
steps: Serve, play it out. First-ball side-out win = a big point.
Side-out but not first-ball -> win a follow-up free-ball rally to earn the point.
Serving team wins -> receivers must win two follow-ups. Play 15 balls, then switch.
library.cue: Rewards clean first-ball side-out. Track big points out loud.

library.name: King of the Court
library.setup: Each court runs its own King of the Court with the teams on it.
steps: King side scores by winning; challenger side wins to move up. Loser out, next in serves.
No open-hand finger tips. An intentional overhand pass attack must travel perpendicular to the shoulders; an attempted set to a partner is the exception.
Rotate a variant every ~8 min: serve-only entry / block = double / cut-or-poke only on king side.
library.cue: Say almost nothing. Tempo surfaces every weak pass - note them.

library.name: Cool-down & debrief
library.setup: Stay in pairs, on court.
steps: Light mobility & stretch: calves, shoulders, hips, wrists.
30 s pair debrief: one thing that worked, one to fix.
library.cue: One collective takeaway. Keep it short - end on energy.

library.name: Partner Passing
library.setup: Pairs ~5 m apart. (Better at Beach #1)
steps: Toss, pass, catch, repeat; give lots of feedback.
Progress: pass back and forth continuously.
Harder: toss to 8 and 4 o'clock, then one arm only, then juggle two balls.
library.cue: Slowest, most technical drill of the day - fix platform angles here.

library.name: Overhead Passing (line of 3)
library.setup: Three in a straight line. (Better at Beach #2)
steps: P1 tosses to P2, who overhead-passes over their head to P3; P2 turns to face P3 and repeats back.
15 passes, then rotate.
Harder: continuous, or two balls with P3 passing a long ball so P2 never turns.
library.cue: Square the hips before the ball arrives - no passing on the turn.

library.name: Triangle / Square Passing
library.setup: 3 in a triangle (4 = square). (Better at Beach #3)
steps: Toss right, pass right, catch, repeat; once smooth, go left.
Progress: continuous passing.
Harder: two or more balls at once.
library.cue: Feet to the ball, deliver to the next station - not just up.

library.name: Passing Groups
library.setup: P1 baseline, P2 receives, P3 target near net (add P4 at the pin if you have one). (Better at Beach #4)
steps: P1 sends 10 balls to P2, who passes to the target; target catches and feeds P1.
Use 2–3 balls; rotate after 10 controlled receptions. Allow the target time to return each ball safely.
Progress: serve instead of throw, move back to full court, then jump serve; work float or topspin.
library.cue: Target quality over speed - a pass the setter can use.

library.name: Butterfly
library.setup: Passing Groups but with constant rotation - follow your ball. (Better at Beach #5)
steps: P1 serves/throws to a passer, who passes to the target; target catches.
After each action, rotate to the next spot (follow the ball).
Progress: serve instead of throw; keep it continuous.
library.cue: Move through the drill under control - reps stay clean at speed.

library.name: Partners Short-Deep
library.setup: Pairs across the net. (Better at Beach #6)
steps: P1 tosses a short ball (~2 m off net); P2 passes it back; then P1 tosses deep (~7 m).
5 short + 5 deep, then switch. Tosses must rise above net height.
Harder: P1 sets to self first; then pokey the short and hit a soft deep ball.
library.cue: Read short vs deep early and get the platform there first.

library.name: Over-the-Net Pepper w/ Switching
library.setup: Three touches each side over the net; extra players rotate out after sending it over. With 7-8, split the court into two. (Better at Beach #7)
steps: Progress the third contact: pass-pass-pass, then pass-set-tomahawk, -pokey, -hit, -jump hit.
If more than two on a side, the player who sends it over rotates out.
Harder: back-sets - P1 goes around P2, who sets behind to P1 to send over.
library.cue: Stay at a progression you can sustain - don't chase the hardest version.

library.name: Server vs Passer (scored)
library.setup: Half court. P1 serves 10 at P2 (passing to P3, the judge). (Better at Beach #8)
steps: Score the passer: perfect pass or missed serve = 3, OK = 2, bad = 1, ace = 0.
Judge counts out loud; only the passer scores. Rotate through the group.
Re-seed by score for a second round so like plays like.
library.cue: Passer wins by never getting aced and rarely giving a bad ball.

library.name: Two-Ball Rhythm Control
library.setup: 3 v 3, a full-time setter each side. Adjust one side if fewer. (Better at Beach #9)
steps: Two balls start at once: P1 throws over to one side while P5 throws to the other.
Three-touch volleyball, middle player sets every second touch; hitters hit line only.
If one ball dies, keep the other alive and re-enter a ball in rhythm. Rotate every 2-3 min; later hit cross.
library.cue: Keep both balls alive - this is a control drill, not a kill drill.

library.name: Hot Potato
library.setup: Pairs; one holds a spare 'potato' ball. (Better at Beach #10)
steps: P1 tosses the play ball; P2 throws the potato up, sets the play ball back, catches the potato. 10x, switch.
Progress: forearm pass instead of set; then both players hold a potato.
Team version: 2v2, each team has a potato they must toss to a partner before playing - 3 touches, never drop it.
library.cue: Forces early, decisive movement - no standing and reaching.

library.name: 6-Touch Pepper
library.setup: Across from a partner. (Better at Beach #11)
steps: Six contacts before sending it over: pass-tomahawk-fist-fist-set-control spike (or pokey-pokey variant).
Never catch - even out of order, keep it up with real volleyball touches.
Fist = contact above the head with palms/closed fingers, not a punch.
library.cue: Trains the emergency touches players skip - keep it airborne.

library.name: Fun Touch Pepper
library.setup: Pairs; coach names a 3-touch sequence. (Better at Beach #12)
steps: Alternate touches while holding the order, e.g. open hand-backhand-fist, or pokey-head-chicken wing.
Be creative and keep it challenging.
Goal: keep the ball alive and keep the sequence correct.
library.cue: Widen the emergency-touch range - laughter allowed.

library.name: Agility Passing
library.setup: 4x4 m box of cones each side; feeder feeds 4 balls, one per cone. (Better at Beach #13)
steps: Pass each ball to a target while moving the pattern with correct footwork, chest to the net.
Pattern 1: figure-8, all forward running.
Pattern 2: figure-8 with diagonal sprints + backpedals. Pattern 3: shuffle-sprint-shuffle, finish with a dive.
library.cue: Fast, balanced, and still a clean platform - movement under control.

library.name: Step-Back Partner Serving
library.setup: Partners across the net at ~half court. (Better at Beach #14)
steps: Serve so your partner catches with no more than one step; they serve back the same way.
Two clean catches in a row -> both step back and repeat.
Progress: jump-float and jump-spike serves.
library.cue: Add power only when accuracy holds - one step, no more.

library.name: Around the World Serving
library.setup: Split each side into 6 zones (3 back, 3 front). (Better at Beach #15)
steps: Serve the zones in order; only advance once you hit the current zone.
Chase your own ball and return to the line quickly. Complete all 6 to finish.
Harder: jump serves; net/out = back a zone (or restart from zone 1).
library.cue: Cold, deliberate accuracy - pick the zone, then execute.

library.name: Servers vs Runners
library.setup: Runner starts opposite the server and may move only at contact. (Better at Beach #16)
steps: Server tries to land it in the court untouched; runner tries to get a hand on it.
Aim a specific zone (e.g. short) and set the runner's start to match.
Harder: runner must make a volleyball touch AND catch to score.
library.cue: Fast, flat, accurate serves that beat a moving defender.

library.name: Deep Rainbow Serves
library.setup: Chairs (or players) ~3 m from the baseline across the court. (Better at Beach #17)
steps: Land the serve behind the chairs, in the court, without touching them.
No chairs? Draw a line 3-4 m from the baseline; a defender inside it tries to touch the serve.
Server keeps the ball out of the defender's reach.
library.cue: High, heavy, deep - the serve that pins passers to the line.

library.name: Zig-Zag Approach
library.setup: Players in a zig-zag down the beach, each with a ball except P1. (Better at Beach #18)
steps: Wait on the power foot facing forward; the next player tosses a ball straight up in front.
Use the power step to the ball and jump straight up-and-down to touch or pokey it.
Work down the line, then the next player leads.
library.cue: Feet to the ball, then vertical - check the footprints for straight take-offs.

library.name: Hitting Lines
library.setup: Coach or partner feeds consistent balls to an attacker. (Better at Beach #19)
steps: Attack with rhythm: work sharp cross, middle, and line.
Progress: attacker tosses to a setter for a simple up-and-down set.
Harder: toss to setter, setter returns a playable ball, then sets - attacker finishes.
library.cue: Groove the approach and arm swing before adding decisions.

library.name: Short-Deep Decision Vision
library.setup: Partners across the net. (Better at Beach #20)
steps: P1 sets a high ball to self; as it goes up P2 moves to the net or deep.
P1 reads P2 and hits to the open space; P2 catches; switch.
Harder: keep it alive by digging and setting to yourself instead of catching.
library.cue: Eyes up on the set - hit where the defender isn't.

library.name: Pokey-Spike Decision Vision
library.setup: Partners across the net. (Better at Beach #21)
steps: P1 sets high to self; as it rises P2 raises hands (block) or leaves them down.
Hands up -> pokey over; hands down -> spike. P2 catches; switch.
Harder: keep it alive without catching.
library.cue: Read the block late and commit to the right shot.

library.name: Listen for Your Partner
library.setup: Set up like Hitting Lines; setter calls the shot. (Better at Beach #22)
steps: P1 jumps to attack hard every ball.
P2 calls during/after the jump: silence = spike hard.
A 'cut' or 'high line' call = execute that shot instead.
library.cue: Trust the caller - late information, correct execution.

library.name: Can't Touch This
library.setup: Coach tosses a high ball mid-court to P1; P2 defends the other side. (Better at Beach #23)
steps: P1 attacks so P2 can't touch it.
Play 1v1, or team-vs-one where the defender stays and attackers rotate through.
Score touches vs clean kills to keep it competitive.
library.cue: Attack off the net into space - make the defender wrong.

library.name: Outside the Box
library.setup: Cone a box 1-2 m off the net and lines; one setter, a line of attackers on the other side. (Better at Beach #24)
steps: Coach feeds easy balls; pass-set-hit anywhere OUTSIDE the box.
New setter after every attacker.
Harder: setter calls the shot on/after the jump; add a blocker/defender to force decisions.
library.cue: Corners and seams, not the middle - place it outside the box.

library.name: Stable Attack vs Defense
library.setup: Attacker on a box 2 m off net / 2 m in from antenna; the cross-court cut is out. (Better at Beach #25)
steps: Attacker tosses high to self and attacks for a point (not into the cut zone).
Defenders may hide their formation until the set; higher levels should.
Defense scores on any error or a 3-touch return; attacker scores otherwise. Mini-games to 7.
library.cue: Stable set, real read - beat a set defense without the easy cut.

library.name: Open Net Power Game
library.setup: Split a half into short/deep; 3 defenders deep, no block; short half is out. (Better at Beach #26)
steps: Attacking side gets free balls, pass-set and hit HARD into the deep court; rotate every point.
Defense scores on hitting errors or a dig that a teammate then catches.
Offense scores when defense can't dig-and-catch. Games to 7.
library.cue: Commit to the hard swing into the deep box.

library.name: Open Net Short Game
library.setup: Split a half into short/deep; 1 defender short; deep half is out. (Better at Beach #27)
steps: Attacking side gets free balls, pass-set and hit into the SHORT court; rotate every point.
Defender scores on hitting errors or a dig they then catch.
Offense scored as a team; games to 7, rotate defenders.
library.cue: Disguise and place the short attack - touch, not power.

library.name: Plus / Minus
library.setup: Offense opposite the coach; two defensive teams swap every 3 points to stay fresh. (Better at Beach #28)
steps: Coach feeds fast free balls to the offense; next feed within 8 s of the last.
Win a rally = +1, lose = -1.
Offense wins the round at +3, loses at -3.
library.cue: Physical side-out grind - hold quality as the legs tire.

library.name: U.S.A.
library.setup: A team each side, others waiting to rotate in. (Better at Beach #29)
steps: Coach throws a joust/near-net ball. Win it = 'U' and receive a free ball; win that = 'US'.
'US' team gets a two-touch ball; win it = 'USA' and then receive serve for the point.
Win the serve-receive = 1 point; either way losers rotate off. Lose an earlier ball = restart at the joust. Play to 3 with a time cap.
library.cue: Chain skills under fatigue - each stage is a different pressure.

library.name: 1-2-3 Drill
library.setup: Two teams on, others waiting. Coach feeds the team with fewer points. (Better at Beach #30)
steps: First time you play the ball = 1 touch only; second time = exactly 2; third and after = 3.
Win having used only 1 touch = 3 pts, only 2 touches = 2 pts, otherwise 1 pt. Wrong touch count ends the point. (Blocks don't count against the sequence.)
Mini-games to 7; first to 5 games wins.
library.cue: Score big by killing early - discipline the touch count.

library.name: On 2
library.setup: Coach feeds a free ball; teams try to attack on 2. (Better at Beach #31)
steps: Goal is a second-ball attack (jump attack at the top level).
The court must produce three dug 'on-2' attacks (not killed) before scoring turns on.
In the scoring phase: on-2 kill = 3 pts, anything else = 1; losing team rotates. First to 7.
library.cue: Attack on 2 when it's there; keep it alive when it isn't.

library.name: Virus
library.setup: Split both sides in half; P1 mid-court with ball, P2 chases, P3 defends opposite half. (Better at Beach #32)
steps: P1 throws a hard-but-playable deep ball; P2 chases and puts up a hittable set.
P1 attacks (into their half only); P3 tries to dig-and-catch.
7 balls per position. Setter+attacker score: kill 3, jump-attack dug-and-caught 2, other dug 1, error 0.
library.cue: Trains the ugliest ball in beach - the set that runs off the net.

library.name: End Game
library.setup: Two teams on, others waiting. (Better at Beach #33)
steps: Start 12-12, game to 15 win-by-2.
Sudden death: a service error, attack error, ball-handling error, or stuff block ends it.
Loser swaps with the waiting team; first to 5 wins overall.
library.cue: Simulate closing a tight set - clean, brave, no cheap errors.

library.name: 3-Man Cross Court
library.setup: P1 and P2 at the antennas one side; P3 defends diagonally. (Better at Beach #34)
steps: P1 hits cross to P3, who digs to mid-court then slides to the other diagonal.
P1 runs in to set P2, returns to the antenna; P2 hits cross to P3; repeat.
Run 2 minutes or 20 digs; if hits are wild, tomahawk/set/pass to the digger instead.
library.cue: Read the diagonal, dig to the middle, reset fast.

library.name: 6-Ball Block Defense
library.setup: Coach attacks from a box; two players in blocker-defender positions, reset each ball. (Better at Beach #35)
steps: 1: hard line into the block. 2: playable cut or high line. 3: the shot not hit on ball 2.
4: ball at the defender, return on two. 5: short ball over the block, return on two.
6: blocker backs off and takes a ball to the face/body. Transition each for a kill.
library.cue: Block, pull, and convert - a full defensive sequence every round.

library.name: Dog House
library.setup: Paradise-style side-out game to 21. One side is the 'Dog House' (can't score); other side scores. (Better at Beach #36)
steps: Coach serves/free-balls the scoring side. Scoring side wins first ball = 1 point, rotate off.
Scoring side loses first ball -> Dog House gets a free ball; win it and swap sides.
You must win two in a row to climb out of the Dog House.
library.cue: Earn your way out - two straight, no shortcuts.

library.name: The Pit
library.setup: One team defends 'The Pit' for 3 minutes; others feed free balls opposite and rotate every point. (Better at Beach #37)
steps: Only the Pit scores: any dig (2 touches, even a fingernail) = a point.
Won rallies and errors by the offense score; a stuff block = 2.
After 3 min, the next team takes the Pit; compare final scores.
library.cue: Reward hustle - every touch is a point, chase everything.

library.name: Retreat & Play the Ball
library.setup: Blocker starts at the net, then drops off to defend. (FIVB 6.6)
steps: On the attacker's slap, the blocker retreats off the net (karaoke footwork, eyes on the net) and plays the driven ball.
Vary the attack: short, deep over the head, hard at the face/body, either side.
Partner sets up or catches the dig; practise dropping off both line and angle.
library.cue: Face the net, be stopped and balanced at contact - then dig.

library.name: Block & Transition Set
library.setup: Blocker at net, defender behind; ball driven past the block. (FIVB 6.7)
steps: Blocker jumps, then turns on the way down and hustles around the dug ball to set the partner.
Defender digs the hard ball high enough to give the blocker time.
With a team each side it becomes continuous angle attacks; get 'around' the ball, shoulders to target.
library.cue: Turn in the air, get around the ball - don't set on the run.

library.name: Retreat Decision Drill
library.setup: Blocker lines up on the attacker; a feeder sets tight or off the net. (FIVB 6.8)
steps: Blocker reads the set and decides: stay and block, or pull off.
Attacker hits into the block or down the line at the retreated blocker.
Add a back defender to play out digs; blocker randomly drops line or angle to train the read.
library.cue: Wind, set trajectory, hitter tendency - decide early, commit.

library.name: Jousting
library.setup: Ball placed on top of the net for two blockers to fight over. (FIVB 6.9)
steps: Two players joust; lock the arm shoulder-to-wrist to bring bodyweight, not just the elbow.
Time the jump so you get the last push; one hand gives more reach.
With a third player, a setter over-sets to create the joust. Work all areas of the net.
library.cue: Aggressive but no net fault - win the top of the net.

library.name: Turn & Get the Shot
library.setup: Blocker goes up with the attacker who plays a 'baby line' shot over the hands. (FIVB 6.10)
steps: Blocker turns coming down and plays the ball up before it lands.
Land with bent knees; get arms under the ball rather than swinging sideways.
A back player sets the dug ball or plays it over on 2.
library.cue: Don't quit on the shot over the block - turn and dig it up.

library.name: Old School - No Blocking
library.setup: Normal game, both defenders back, no block. Draw an 8 ft line. (FIVB 8.6)
steps: Attacker must leave the ground behind the 8 ft line to attack.
Defenders start low and read the attacker's shoulder, approach and the wind.
Harder: move the line to 6 ft, make it two-touch, or drop to the sand each time the ball crosses. Works as a King/Queen format with 6-8.
library.cue: Pure reading and court coverage - anticipate, don't react.

library.name: Serve / Dig / Joust
library.setup: Serve and a normal rally, then two coach-fed balls. (FIVB 8.7)
steps: After the rally the coach drives a ball at the receiving team's defender - play it out.
Then the coach tosses a ball between the blockers to joust - play it out.
Swap servers and repeat; score a point for winning all 3 of 3 (or 2 each with 5 balls).
library.cue: Side-out, then defend, then joust - stay disciplined when tired.

library.name: Monarch of the Court
library.setup: Points side vs challenger side; 3+ teams. (FIVB 8.8)
steps: Challengers serve; win the rally to cross to the points side.
Points side wins the rally = a point and stays.
Choose your rules: missed serves score or not; moving up scores or not; points side allowed 2 errors before out.
library.cue: A cleaner King-of-the-Court - set the serving rule and let it run.

library.name: Serve / Free / Down (wash)
library.setup: Three-ball wash starting with a serve. (FIVB 8.9)
steps: Ball 1: serve and rally. Ball 2: winner receives a down ball. Ball 3: then a free ball.
Win all 3 = a big point; split 2:1 = a wash (replay).
If a team wins none of the 3, the opponent also gets a big point. Optionally play sets of 5.
library.cue: String together side-out and transition - reward the full sequence.

library.name: Baseball
library.setup: Receiving team = batters, serving team = pitchers; extra teams wait. (FIVB 8.10)
steps: Win a rally = one base; missed serve = a walk (one base); ace = strikeout + switch.
Lose a rally on receive = a strikeout; 4 rallies won = a home run = a run.
3 strikeouts and teams switch serve/receive; play set innings, most runs wins.
library.cue: Fun frame, serious side-out reps - keep the pressure of the count.

library.name: Modified 1-on-1 (2/3 touch)
library.setup: 1v1 on a modified court (long-thin or short-fat). (FIVB 8.11)
steps: Coach tosses in; play out the rally using exactly 2 or 3 touches each.
Winner of the rally scores; play to a set score, then switch sides.
Harder: serve to start; coach feeds an extra ball to the rally winner for a bonus point.
library.cue: Maximal touches on every skill - get back to base after each play.

library.name: Over on 1
library.setup: Pick a target spot (e.g. deep corner). (FIVB 8.13)
steps: Server serves, then moves to the target spot to defend.
Receivers must attack into the chosen spot; miss it and the server scores.
The dug ball is sent straight back over to play out; with advanced players use soft shots so rallies last.
library.cue: Attack a spot on a normal approach - turn the ball with the wrist.

library.name: Standing Shot Game
library.setup: Normal game, no jumping allowed. (FIVB 8.14)
steps: Play out points using only standing shots - take a look at the defence before every contact.
Option: double points for any ball that lands untouched, to reward commitment.
Option: setter calls a specific shot to force communication.
library.cue: Eyes up, feet under the ball, place it away from the defender.

library.name: Manchette-Game (bump + reset)
library.setup: Pairs/threes over a short space. (from your notes)
steps: Keep the ball up with forearm passes only.
After every contact, sprint to touch the net post or baseline, then recover into the rally.
Progress: two touches (bump-set), then one-arm only.
library.cue: Emergency control under fatigue - platform first, feet always moving.

library.name: Bagger-Massaker (Dig Massacre)
library.setup: Forearm-only game across the net in a tight space; each player/pair has 3-4 lives. (from your notes)
steps: Rally with forearm passes only - no hands.
Lose a rally = lose a life; when you're out you drop to the 'loser court'.
Last one standing wins; shrink the space (3 m) to force control.
library.cue: Everything is a dig - keep it alive, no hands.

library.name: Norweger (Norwegian game)
library.setup: 5v5 or 4v4 across a beach court, no jumping, two touches per side. (from your notes)
steps: Start cooperative: two touches together, chase long rallies.
Switch to competitive two-touch points.
Change sides at a set score; add defense line/cut/hard-dia constraints.
library.cue: Big-group, low-intensity activation that still competes.

library.name: Reaction pepper (pass = bump)
library.setup: Pairs, one ball. (from your notes)
steps: Call the opposite: 'pass' means bump, 'bump/manchette' means hand-set.
Hold the sequence and keep the ball alive.
Speed the calls up as they settle in.
library.cue: Forces a read before every contact - no autopilot.

library.name: 6 Guns pepper
library.setup: Pairs, one ball, continuous. (from your notes)
steps: Cycle fast pepper (low, quick balls).
Then handcuffed (contact in front only), then one-arm only.
Keep it unbroken through all three.
library.cue: Widen the control range - quick hands, quiet platform.

library.name: 3 m bump control
library.setup: Pairs in a 3 m space, in front of then behind the 3 m line. (from your notes)
steps: Forearm-pass only in the tight space.
Then two touches (bump-bump) working behind the line.
Stay controlled - short and precise.
library.cue: Tiny space, perfect platform - control before power.

library.name: Nähmaschine reception footwork
library.setup: Feeder at the net, receiver on the baseline; fast 'sewing-machine' feet. (from your notes)
steps: Shuffle in with quick small steps and pass the fed ball to target.
Recover and repeat; 2 series each.
Start facing front, then work stepping back off a deep ball.
library.cue: Fast feet to a stopped, balanced platform.

library.name: Core & knee stability circuit
library.setup: In threes, own space. (from your notes)
steps: Leg-axis / knee stability 10 each side; shoulder stability 15x.
Plank with leg circles.
Single-leg jumps: front, back, right, left.
library.cue: Prime the joints beach punishes - ankles, knees, shoulders.

library.name: Sand coordination squares
library.setup: A 4-square grid in the sand; a feeder tosses. (from your notes)
steps: Move to the next square on each ball, one-touch pass to target.
Second round: two touches per square.
Mix in lunges, star-walks and coordination circles around a ball.
library.cue: Balance and change of direction in deep sand.

library.name: 3v3 King Court warm-up
library.setup: 3 per side, King-Court rotation. (from your notes)
steps: Exactly one touch per player, so the side must play all three.
Switch sides over the net after each ball.
Win to stay/advance, lose and rotate.
library.cue: Light, touch-everyone activation with a competitive edge.

library.name: Einspielen - 2v2 over the net
library.setup: 2v2 over the net, both courts. (from your notes)
steps: Controlled three-touch rallies over the net.
Rotate front/back each ball; add a block jump and a line shot.
Touch the baseline after each attack, then recover.
library.cue: Game-tempo warm-up - clean touches, real approaches.

library.name: Line & Diagonal hitting (rotation)
library.setup: Groups of 3-4, one setter; work line then cross. (from your notes)
steps: Pass/toss to the setter and attack line.
Next round attack diagonal; after each attack move into the setting role.
Swap the group every 2 attacks.
library.cue: Repeat the approach and finish in both directions.

library.name: Einschlagen - attack vs block & defense
library.setup: Two teams work at once: one serves, the other blocks + defends; rotate the attacking side. (from your notes)
steps: Serve, reception, set, then a controlled attack against a real block and defender.
The defender digs and sets a return attack (side change).
Change sides after 2x6 reps; add a service before running to block.
library.cue: The core beach rep - full side-out and transition against resistance.

library.name: Block & pull (Block lösen)
library.setup: One player at the net, 2v2 or 3v3. (from your notes)
steps: Every second ball the net player either blocks or pulls off to defend.
Partner covers the rest of the court.
Read the set early to decide block vs pull; work an easy serve to the left, then the right.
library.cue: Commit to block or pull early - no half-measures at the net.

library.name: Out-of-system setting
library.setup: 3-4 per court; a high ball is thrown deep to a back corner. (from your notes)
steps: A player chases the off-net ball and delivers a hittable set.
Partner attacks it, or catches for a control focus.
Rotate through; work both back corners.
library.cue: Turn a bad ball into a hittable set - the shot that wins beach.

library.name: Square passing with rotation
library.setup: Four players on the corners of a square (add a runner). (from your notes)
steps: Pass to the next corner and follow your ball to that spot.
Keep it continuous; then reverse direction.
Aim ~20 clean passes as a group.
library.cue: Platform to target, then move - passing on the go.

library.name: Reception-set rotation (catch & rotate)
library.setup: Server, receiver, target (setter) per court. (from your notes)
steps: Serve, reception to the target, target catches.
Rotate server -> receiver -> target.
10-20 balls each side; keep the target consistent.
library.cue: Clean first contact to a consistent target every time.

library.name: Serve to 4 zones
library.setup: Full serving, own ball. (from your notes)
steps: Mark four quadrants: short left, short right, deep left, deep right. Serve 2 balls to each.
Chase your ball and reset quickly.
Progress: float then jump serve to each zone.
library.cue: Land every serve on a called spot.

library.name: Serve & targeted reception (line vs cut)
library.setup: Two teams, one serving on each court; one fixed receiver. (from your notes)
steps: 20 serves, 10 at the same passer.
The passer plays 10 receptions that set up a line shot, then 10 that set up a cut.
Then swap serving/receiving roles.
library.cue: Pressure serving plus reception that sets up a specific shot.

library.name: Auto-smash & play out
library.setup: Pairs across the net. (from your notes)
steps: Self-toss and attack over the net, then play the rally out.
10 balls line, 10 cross.
Add a blocker or defender to force real reads.
library.cue: Attack, then compete - finish and defend.

library.name: Correction-step attack
library.setup: Feeder near the net. (from your notes)
steps: 3 approach jumps to feel the last adjusting step (left/right/front/back).
Then approach and spike a fed ball.
Coach checks the footprints for a straight take-off.
library.cue: The last correction step puts you behind the ball.

library.name: Back-set + line attack
library.setup: Threes: passer, setter, attacker at the pin. (from your notes)
steps: Pass to the setter, who back-sets to the pin.
Attacker finishes line; then rotate.
Square the shoulders and deliver the back-set high.
library.cue: Hide the direction, set it high to the pin.

library.name: Cut & line shot (continuous)
library.setup: Pairs/threes, auto-fed salt & pepper. (from your notes)
steps: Alternate controlled cut shots and line shots, continuously.
Keep the ball in play throughout.
Add a defender to read and place away from.
library.cue: Soft hands, sharp placement - repeatable shots.

library.name: Standshot & defense with 2nd ball
library.setup: Coach with two balls at the net. (from your notes)
steps: Player plays a standing attack, then immediately a 2nd ball.
Next round: dig the first ball, then a 2nd defensive ball.
Rapid back-to-back reps, then rotate.
library.cue: Reset fast - two live actions in a row.

library.name: 18:15 Sideout game
library.setup: 2v2; one team serves; start 18:15, play to 21. (from your notes)
steps: Serve vs side-out from a tight score.
Switch serve/defense roles every 2 balls; same player receives.
Variation: only second-ball attacks, or jump on every attack.
library.cue: Close-score side-out pressure from the first ball.

library.name: Speed sideout (15:12 to 21)
library.setup: Teams rotate on one court; start 15:12 to 21. (from your notes)
steps: Fast feeds, minimal downtime.
The side that wins the point rotates; a team may blow max 3 side-outs before a penalty.
Variation: the first attack must be on 2.
library.cue: Relentless tempo - hold side-out quality as it speeds up.

library.name: Seilziehen / Tug-of-War (+/-)
library.setup: Two teams head-to-head with coach free-balls and a shared counter. (from your notes)
steps: Win a rally and the counter moves your way.
Reach +3 / +4 to win the round - but a win must be confirmed with one more side-out.
Loser switches out with a waiting team.
library.cue: Momentum game - win the confirming ball, don't let it swing back.

library.name: Survivor 4v2
library.setup: 4 attackers vs 2 defenders. (from your notes)
steps: Attackers must play on 3 (full pass-set-attack).
Defenders survive and score by digging and covering.
Rotate attackers through the two defenders.
library.cue: Outnumbered defense - read, communicate, cover.

library.name: 7 Sideouts (shot progression)
library.setup: The same receiver takes 7 side-outs in a row. (from your notes)
steps: Attack line first, then cut, then open/free choice, then play the rally out.
Team keeps a target of clean side-outs.
Rotate the receiver after the set of 7.
library.cue: Don't speculate - execute the called shot, then compete.

library.name: Mini-sets to 7 with handicap
library.setup: 2v2, short sets to 7. (from your notes)
steps: Give the weaker pairing a 1-2 point handicap (start 14:14, 16:14, etc.).
Winner stays, loser rotates.
Adjust the handicap so sets stay tight.
library.cue: Level the match so every point matters.

library.name: Standshot King of the Court
library.setup: 2v2 King-Court, standing shots only. (from your notes)
steps: Minimum two touches; a teammate touch is required between contacts 1 and 2.
Win to move up, lose and rotate.
No jumping - placement and teamwork only.
library.cue: Win with shots and communication, not power.

library.name: King Court with confirmation
library.setup: Standard King-Court across the court. (from your notes)
steps: Win a rally to move up as usual.
But you must confirm it by winning the next side-out to bank the point / stay.
Miss the confirm and you don't advance.
library.cue: Back-to-back balls - prove the point before it counts.

library.name: Side-out / defense big-point chain
library.setup: 2v2, one team feeds. (from your notes)
steps: Win a side-out, then win a defensive rally = one big point.
Keep chaining big points until an error.
Then swap sides and repeat.
library.cue: String side-out and transition together without a mistake.

library.name: Team + extra attacker (continuous)
library.setup: A full team plus one extra 'attacker' who stays in. (from your notes)
steps: Continuous rallies feeding the extra attacker 10 balls.
Then rotate the attacker in.
Keep the flow going - minimal resets.
library.cue: High-volume attacking reps under game flow.

library.name: Four-pass setting decisions
library.setup: 3 per group: feeder deep, moving setter, target 1–2 m off the net.
steps: Feed a comfortable pass, then vary it tight, deep or wide.
Setter chooses a hand set or bump set to the target; target catches.
Score one for a catchable set with space from the net. Rotate every 5 feeds.
library.cue: Arrive balanced; choose the contact you can control.
library.progression: Easier: predictable tosses. Harder: target attacks into the opposite court.

library.name: Serve, receive, set, catch
library.setup: 3 per group: server behind one end line, receiver and setting target opposite.
steps: Serve or toss over the net. Receiver calls early and passes to partner.
Partner sets; original receiver moves to catch at an attacking point off the net.
Count 5 catchable sequences together, then rotate roles.
library.cue: Pass, connect, then move again.
library.progression: Easier: closer toss. Harder: attack instead of catch.
library.sourceLabel: Coaching adaptation · USA Volleyball game-based principles

library.name: Seam ownership challenge
library.setup: 4 per court: server and collector opposite two receivers.
steps: Receivers agree who owns the seam before each serve.
Server alternates seam, short and deep serves; receivers call before contact.
A controlled pass plus an early call earns one; swap pairs after 6 serves.
library.cue: Decide together before the serve.
library.progression: Easier: toss from inside court. Harder: vary serving position.
library.sourceLabel: Coaching adaptation · USA Volleyball game-based principles

library.name: Dig, set, send
library.setup: Feeder on one side; defender and partner on the other. Extra players collect.
steps: Feeder sends a controlled standing attack to the defender.
Partner moves to set the dig; defender sends a controlled third contact over.
Reset after each sequence and rotate all roles after 5 feeds.
library.cue: Make the dig high enough for your partner.
library.progression: Easier: feed a free ball. Harder: unpredictable standing shots.
library.sourceLabel: Coaching adaptation · USA Volleyball game-based principles

library.name: Cooperative three-contact streak
library.setup: 2v2 across the net; extras replace a pair every 90 seconds.
steps: Start with an easy toss and use pass, set, controlled third contact.
Both teams count consecutive net crossings together; aim for 6.
On an error restart the count with an easy ball. Change partners next round.
library.cue: Send a ball the other pair can play.
library.progression: Easier: allow a catch on contact two. Harder: standing shots to space.
library.sourceLabel: Coaching adaptation · USA Volleyball game-based principles

library.name: Side-out plus transition confirmation
library.setup: 2v2 per court; waiting team feeds the second ball and collects.
steps: Play a serve rally. Receiving team must win it to unlock a confirmation ball.
Immediately feed an easy ball to that team; winning this rally earns one big point.
After two rally sequences rotate a waiting team in; first to 5 big points wins.
library.cue: Reset quickly after the first rally.
library.progression: Easier: a controlled feed instead of serve. Harder: a down ball for confirmation.
library.sourceLabel: Coaching adaptation · USA Volleyball game-based principles

library.name: See the space: line or cut
library.setup: Feeder and attacker below the net; one defender above it. Spare players collect.
steps: Feeder tosses a hittable ball off the net; defender chooses line or cross-court early.
Attacker looks before contact and plays a controlled shot toward the open area.
Play one ball at a time; rotate attacker → defender → feeder after 5 balls.
library.cue: See space before choosing your shot.
library.progression: Easier: standing shots. Harder: defender moves later.
library.sourceLabel: Coaching adaptation · USA Volleyball game-based principles

library.name: Finish at 18–18
library.setup: 2v2 per court; waiting pairs enter at the end of each mini-set.
steps: Start at 18–18; normal rally scoring to 21, win by two.
Switch sides after each combined 7 points, counting from 36.
After the mini-set rotate the waiting pair in and alternate the first serving team.
library.cue: Choose one serving plan and commit to it.
library.progression: Easier: start 6–6, play to 9. Harder: each pair names a tactical goal.
library.sourceLabel: Coaching adaptation · USA Volleyball game-based principles
